summary: Small ML corrections with a measurable effect: the small-seed model comparison declared false improvements, the mass-sculpting baseline used one draw, a constant training feature was divided by 1e-12, and the model hash covered the checkpoint file instead of the weights.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the script's first release: its bootstrap decision from the start; fd637dcc (exact permutation, over-corrected) and db40e842 (Student-t) both first shipped in 0.10.0
the first release of mass_sculpting_jsd and of the trainer's standardization and model_hash

observables: model-comparison verdict with fewer than 10 seeds (compare_model_runs.py)
training on a feature constant on the training split
impact.bias: with 3, 5 or 10 paired seeds the bootstrap decision declared an improvement in 26%, 15% and 11% of null comparisons (now 5.7%, 5.3%, 5.1% at 3, 5, 9 seeds against a nominal 5%); the sculpting baseline came from one resampling; a constant feature was standardized by 1e-12; model_hash changed with paths and optimizer state, not only the weights
impact.trigger: a model comparison with fewer than 10 seeds, a mass-sculpting check, a feature constant on the training split, or comparing model_hash across runs

remedy: rerun compare_model_runs.py and the sculpting check, and retrain a model with a constant feature, with a release that has the fix; compare models by the new weights-only model_hash
